Replace 极速传送带 (Mk.III, itemId=2003) with 高速传送带 (Mk.II, itemId=2002)
in a Dyson Sphere Program blueprint file.
"""
import base64
import gzip
import struct
import sys
import os

BLUEPRINT_FILE = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)), "红黄蓝紫糖60.txt")

MKIII_BELT_ITEM_ID = 2003
MKII_BELT_ITEM_ID = 2002
MKIII_BELT_MODEL_INDEX = 37
MKII_BELT_MODEL_INDEX = 36

def parse_and_replace(data: bytearray) -> int:
    """Parse blueprint binary data and replace Mk.III belt with Mk.II belt.
    Returns the number of replacements made."""
    offset = 0
    replacements = 0

    # Header
    version = struct.unpack_from('<i', data, offset)[0]
    offset += 4
    cursor_offset_x = struct.unpack_from('<i', data, offset)[0]
    offset += 4
    cursor_offset_y = struct.unpack_from('<i', data, offset)[0]
    offset += 4
    cursor_target_area = struct.unpack_from('<i', data, offset)[0]
    offset += 4
    drag_box_size_x = struct.unpack_from('<i', data, offset)[0]
    offset += 4
    drag_box_size_y = struct.unpack_from('<i', data, offset)[0]
    offset += 4
    primary_area_idx = struct.unpack_from('<i', data, offset)[0]
    offset += 4
    num_areas = struct.unpack_from('<B', data, offset)[0]
    offset += 1

    print(f"Blueprint version: {version}")
    print(f"Number of areas: {num_areas}")

    # Areas
    for i in range(num_areas):
        offset += 1  # index
        offset += 1  # parentIndex
        offset += 2  # tropicAnchor
        offset += 2  # areaSegments
        offset += 2  # anchorLocalOffset_x
        offset += 2  # anchorLocalOffset_y
        offset += 2  # width
        offset += 2  # height

    num_buildings = struct.unpack_from('<i', data, offset)[0]
    offset += 4
    print(f"Number of buildings: {num_buildings}")

    for i in range(num_buildings):
        offset += 4  # index
        offset += 1  # areaIndex
        offset += 4 * 3  # localOffset x,y,z
        offset += 4 * 3  # localOffset2 x,y,z
        offset += 4  # yaw
        offset += 4  # yaw2

        item_id_offset = offset
        item_id = struct.unpack_from('<h', data, offset)[0]
        offset += 2

        model_index_offset = offset
        model_index = struct.unpack_from('<h', data, offset)[0]
        offset += 2

        if item_id == MKIII_BELT_ITEM_ID:
            struct.pack_into('<h', data, item_id_offset, MKII_BELT_ITEM_ID)
            struct.pack_into('<h', data, model_index_offset, MKII_BELT_MODEL_INDEX)
            replacements += 1

        offset += 4  # outputObjIdx
        offset += 4  # inputObjIdx
        offset += 4  # outputToSlot
        offset += 4  # inputFromSlot
        offset += 4  # outputFromSlot
        offset += 4  # inputToSlot
        offset += 1  # outputOffset
        offset += 1  # inputOffset
        offset += 2  # recipeId
        offset += 2  # filterId

        param_count = struct.unpack_from('<h', data, offset)[0]
        offset += 2
        offset += 4 * param_count  # parameters (int32 each)

    print(f"Parsed {num_buildings} buildings, offset={offset}, data length={len(data)}")
    print(f"Replaced {replacements} Mk.III belts with Mk.II belts")
    return replacements


def main():
    with open(BLUEPRINT_FILE, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        content = f.read()

    # Split header and data at the first double-quote
    quote_idx = content.index('"')
    header = content[:quote_idx]
    b64_data = content[quote_idx + 1:]

    # Strip trailing quote if present
    if b64_data.endswith('"'):
        b64_data = b64_data[:-1]

    print(f"Header: {header[:100]}...")
    print(f"Base64 data length: {len(b64_data)}")

    # Also update item IDs in the header if present

    # Header numbers 6004,6003,6002,6001 might just be coordinates, not item IDs

    # Decode and decompress
    compressed = base64.b64decode(b64_data)
    raw_data = bytearray(gzip.decompress(compressed))
    print(f"Decompressed data length: {len(raw_data)}")

    replacements = parse_and_replace(raw_data)

    if replacements == 0:
        print("No Mk.III belts found. Nothing to change.")
        return

    # Recompress and re-encode
    new_compressed = gzip.compress(bytes(raw_data))
    new_b64 = base64.b64encode(new_compressed).decode('ascii')

    # Write output
    new_content = header + '"' + new_b64
    if content.endswith('"'):
        new_content += '"'

    with open(BLUEPRINT_FILE, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        f.write(new_content)

    print(f"Successfully wrote modified blueprint back to file.")
    print(f"Original base64 length: {len(b64_data)}, New base64 length: {len(new_b64)}")


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

---

## Blueprint String Overall Structure

A blueprint string has the format:
```
BLUEPRINT:<HEADER>"<BASE64_BINARY_DATA>"<MD5_HASH>
```

1. **HEADER**: The string between `BLUEPRINT:` and the first `"`, split by commas into an array called `cells`.
2. **Binary data**: The string between the first `"` and the second `"` is Base64-decoded into a byte stream. The byte stream starts at the META section and fields are read sequentially.

---

## HEADER (String, comma-separated)

| Field | Type | cells index | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| flag0 | - | cells[0] | 1 = author/customVersion/externalFields exist (added V0.10.34.28281); 0 = default |
| layout | Number | cells[1] | Blueprint icon layout |
| icons | Array(5) | cells[2..6] | Blueprint icons (5 numbers) |
| time | Date | cells[8] | Creation time |
| gameVersion | String | cells[9] | Game version string |
| shortDesc | String | cells[10] | Thumbnail text |
| author | String | cells[11] | Author (added V0.10.34.28281) |
| customVersion | String | cells[12] | Custom blueprint version (added V0.10.34.28281) |
| externalFields | String | cells[13] | Custom properties, e.g. `key1:val1;key2:val2;` (added V0.10.34.28281) |
| desc | String | flag0>=1 ? cells[14] : cells[11] | Blueprint description |

---

## META (Binary byte stream, fields read sequentially)

| Field | Type | Size (bytes) | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| version | Int32 | 4 | 2 = has reformData (added V0.10.33.26934); 1 = default |
| cursorOffset.x | Float32 | 4 | Mouse anchor offset X for blueprint preview |
| cursorOffset.y | Float32 | 4 | Mouse anchor offset Y |
| cursorTargetArea | Int32 | 4 | Corresponding areas index, usually 0 |
| dragBoxSize.x | Float32 | 4 | Drag-copy interval width |
| dragBoxSize.y | Float32 | 4 | Drag-copy interval height |
| primaryAreaIdx | Int32 | 4 | Corresponding areas index, usually 0 |
| numAreas | UInt8 | 1 | Length of areas array (read-only), usually 1 |
| areas | AREA[] | numAreas * 14 | Array of AREA objects |
| numBuildings | Int32 | 4 | Length of buildings array (read-only) |
| buildings | BUILDING[] | variable | Array of BUILDING objects |
| patch | Int32 | 4 | Reserved field (added V0.10.33.26934) |
| reformDataFlag | UInt8 | 1 | Whether reform data exists (added V0.10.33.26934) |
| reformData | REFORM_DATA | variable | Foundation data (added V0.10.33.26934) |

Note: `patch`, `reformDataFlag`, and `reformData` only exist when `version >= 2`.

---

## AREA Object (14 bytes each)

| Field | Type | Size (bytes) | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| index | UInt8 | 1 | Array index |
| parentIndex | UInt8 | 1 | |
| tropicAnchor | Int16 | 2 | |

---

## Blueprint String Overall Structure

A blueprint string has the format:
```
BLUEPRINT:<HEADER>"<BASE64_BINARY_DATA>"<MD5_HASH>
```

1. **HEADER**: The string between `BLUEPRINT:` and the first `"`, split by commas into an array called `cells`.
2. **Binary data**: The string between the first `"` and the second `"` is Base64-decoded into a byte stream. The byte stream starts at the META section and fields are read sequentially.

---

## HEADER (String, comma-separated)

| Field | Type | cells index | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| flag0 | - | cells[0] | 1 = author/customVersion/externalFields exist (added V0.10.34.28281); 0 = default |
| layout | Number | cells[1] | Blueprint icon layout |
| icons | Array(5) | cells[2..6] | Blueprint icons (5 numbers) |
| time | Date | cells[8] | Creation time |
| gameVersion | String | cells[9] | Game version string |
| shortDesc | String | cells[10] | Thumbnail text |
| author | String | cells[11] | Author (added V0.10.34.28281) |
| customVersion | String | cells[12] | Custom blueprint version (added V0.10.34.28281) |
| externalFields | String | cells[13] | Custom properties, e.g. `key1:val1;key2:val2;` (added V0.10.34.28281) |
| desc | String | flag0>=1 ? cells[14] : cells[11] | Blueprint description |

---

## META (Binary byte stream, fields read sequentially)

| Field | Type | Size (bytes) | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| version | Int32 | 4 | 2 = has reformData (added V0.10.33.26934); 1 = default |
| cursorOffset.x | Float32 | 4 | Mouse anchor offset X for blueprint preview |
| cursorOffset.y | Float32 | 4 | Mouse anchor offset Y |
| cursorTargetArea | Int32 | 4 | Corresponding areas index, usually 0 |
| dragBoxSize.x | Float32 | 4 | Drag-copy interval width |
| dragBoxSize.y | Float32 | 4 | Drag-copy interval height |
| primaryAreaIdx | Int32 | 4 | Corresponding areas index, usually 0 |
| numAreas | UInt8 | 1 | Length of areas array (read-only), usually 1 |
| areas | AREA[] | numAreas * 14 | Array of AREA objects |
| numBuildings | Int32 | 4 | Length of buildings array (read-only) |
| buildings | BUILDING[] | variable | Array of BUILDING objects |
| patch | Int32 | 4 | Reserved field (added V0.10.33.26934) |
| reformDataFlag | UInt8 | 1 | Whether reform data exists (added V0.10.33.26934) |
| reformData | REFORM_DATA | variable | Foundation data (added V0.10.33.26934) |
